chapter_title: Concerning the Three Things that were established
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:** Three conditions must be brought into being by Divine Wisdom out of the necessity of Divine Order itself. There is no other outcome, nor can they be left unaccomplished, for falsity from evil — the adversary that rose up against Divine Truth from the very origin — must be restrained and subdued by them. Because of this, these things admit no other outcome; they cannot remain undone.

---

**¶3:** Now, the first condition is the new state of the natural mind illuminated by wisdom, which was established and formed upon the existing natural mind [GAP-1] — that is, upon the selfhood, the nature foreign to spiritual life [GAP-2] — formed over it.

---

**¶4:** The second condition is this: They will [GAP-3] and they [GAP-4] the new regenerated natural mind, the sealed containment [GAP-5] of infernal self-love, the power conjoined with falsity from evil.

---

**¶5:** The third condition concerns the perverted affections of all who have confirmed themselves in evil and who stand condemned by their own works. They were [GAP-6] over them lamentation; they have been judged according to the evil states they had made their own, and because of this they will be permanently fixed upon the very falsity that had exalted itself against the Divine.

---

**¶6:** They will seal forever this final mass of unregenerate nature when all the appearances and semblances of every form of falsity are permanently fastened within it. Also, those evils will be bound by this last restraint for eternity, and will be set as what is lowest and most abased — a base, a covering, and a remnant beneath the permanent enclosure [GAP-7] — which is the eternal prison of falsity from evil. It will be established as a perpetual boundary and a great void of separation between the two natures — between the state of spiritual ignorance and the adversary of active falsity — so that they can no longer reach one another, nor can any influx pass between them; rather they will become utterly barren, being separated from each other to eternity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three things would be fashioned by the Light through necessity. For there can be no other way nor other result, to allow them to stay without coming about. For the Darkness, the Enemy, must be bound by them; he who stood up against the Light from the beginning. Due to this, these things have no (other) result, to allow them to stay without coming about.
Now, the first thing is the new luminous earth, which was set and built on top of this earth [beneath] it, namely that alien body [and was] built upon it.
The second thing is this: They will [fashion] and they [will build] the new earth, the coffin [and prison] of the Dark Fire, the companion of the Enemy.

The third thing is the souls of all the sinners who have been condemned by their deeds. They were [judged, and there was] over them woe; they have been condemned according to the wicked deeds they had committed, and due to this they will be crucified on the Enemy, he who had raised himself up against the Greatness.

They will seal up this final lump when all the likenesses and images of every shape will be nailed in it. Also, those will be bound by this last fetter for eternity, and be placed as a footstool and a mat and a rag for this coffin [and tomb] which is the prison of the Enemy. It will be placed, being a boundary-marker and a great void between the two, between the Darkness and the Enemy, so that they cannot reach one another, nor can they hear their voices; rather they will become sterile as they are separated from each other for ever and ever.

fills.explanation: The new luminous earth is built "on top of" the old earth; GAP-1 specifies the spatial relation of the old earth to the new, clarifying it lies beneath it — the existing natural mind (proprium) underlying the regenerated plane.

The clause continues the main verb chain ("was set and built... and was built upon it"), describing the new luminous earth as formed over the alien body (proprium/selfhood), paralleling the spiritual reading's "formed over it."
Standard Kephalaia creation verb (Coptic tamio), parallel to ¶3's "set and built" and ¶2's "fashioned by the Light"; describes the construction of the containment vessel for infernal self-love.

Parallel construction verb completing the pair with "fashion," directly echoing ¶3's "built" (Coptic kōt); together they describe the making of the new earth as coffin and containment of the Dark Fire.

Natural pairing of containment terms ("coffin and prison") matching the spiritual reading's "sealed containment" and paralleling ¶6's explicit reference to "the prison of the Enemy" in the same structural position.

Creates the thematic progression judged → woe → condemned → crucified; the spiritual reading indicates lamentation pronounced over them as a consequence of judgment, preceding the explicit condemnation stated in the next clause.

Natural funerary-containment pairing with "coffin," expressing the spiritual reading's "permanent enclosure" — the double image of coffin and tomb emphasizes the irreversibility of the Enemy's confinement for eternity.
